theme: Dark Mode Command Center (Archetype 4: Swiss Brutalist + Technical)

rules.anti_patterns: NO Inter, Roboto, or Lato for headings. NO generic bolding. Use tracking-tight for sizes > 32px.

colors.anti_patterns: NO pure black (#000000). NO generic full-screen gradients. NO teal green or teal blue (#1B93A4).

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Use border-collapse style layouts. 1px solid strokes instead of soft shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for sticky headers/floating panels: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.agent_chat: Retro-Futurism / Terminal Look. Deep black background, Volt Blue text for agent responses, subtle drop-shadow glow.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity-5) on the main background to break the digital flatness.

components.strategy: Shadcn UI combined with raw HTML/Tailwind for layouts.
components.modifications: Strip Vercel-like soft shadows. Use sharp edges or max 4px (rounded-sm) border-radius. Override tablist height (h-9 to h-auto).
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select. NO native HTML inputs.
components.charts: Shadcn charts or Recharts for pipeline metrics.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: The 'Bento' Grid Protocol - Mode B (High Density Grid).
grids_and_layouts.base: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous internal padding (p-6, p-8) to prevent text collision. Dense outer grid gaps.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align dense data, lists, and forms.

motion.rules: Minimalist. Micro-interactions for feedback. NO generic 'transition-all'.
motion.agent_feed: Smooth stagger entrances for agent registry and chat panels.

accessibility.contrast: APCA preferred. Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (kebab-case, role-based).

media.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense dashboard clarity.
media.illustrations: Avoid generic vectors. Rely on typography and grid lines for structure.

ai_agents.description: Glowing eyes emanate from a digital face (Main Orchestrator Agent)
Futuristic digital head with code projection (Evaluation Agent)
Black and white robot illustration (Scheduling Agent)

human_personas.description: Business professional in blue suit (Delivery Manager Profile)

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js and .jsx files in the current setup. DO NOT output or assume .tsx files.
Implement a dark mode toggle, but default the application to 'dark' theme.
Build the dashboard using a 'command center' technical aesthetic: stark grids, 1px visible borders, high density, and monospace metadata.
Design the 6-agent chat panels using a terminal-inspired look: dark backgrounds, high-contrast Volt Blue text for agent responses, clear layout distinction between human and agent messages.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds under content. Use glassmorphism or solid fills.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (e.g., sharp technical buttons) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use 'sonner' for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js or .jsx.
